description: Pauses are counted by part, not by character: the join keeps the periods in the label of an opaque part, makes each run of pause parts one, and leaves out a pause part at either end. The phonemes join in the same way, with `?` for the part (engine §5).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text [{part}]
%rule part v | pause | y
%rule v :- $.verbatim-text | ("a" "." "." "b") %emits $ :: V


%rule pause "-" %emits $ :: (P ∪ Sound-002E-s) := "." :- " "

%rule y "y" %emits $ :: (Y ∪ Sound-0079-s) := "y"

```

%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text all %emits $ :: Z

%rule all [{any}]
%rule any V | P | Y
